title.zh: 多结果接合的共同关系结构
title.en: Common relational structure for multivalued joining

claim.zh: 有限结果接合的两份精确约简分支说明具有唯一的已用代码对齐，保持所有可能输出类；代码结果可从任意原来指定的同码输入对提升。
claim.en: Two exact reduced branch accounts of finite-outcome joining have a unique alignment on used codes preserving all possible outcome classes; each code outcome lifts from any originally specified input pair with those codes.

hypotheses.zh: 同一部分接合 J；每对输入具有有限结果集合。
hypotheses.en: One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.

hypotheses.zh: 目标含全部有限否定、合取、左右接合后继问题，无独立原子谓词。
hypotheses.en: The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.

hypotheses.zh: Exact 给出完整精确答案；Reduced 仅用于最小代码与输出代码的提升。
hypotheses.en: Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

detail.zh: 检查过的同一接合到模态模型适配。
detail.en: Checked adapter from the same joining to the modal model.

output.zh: same_iff_bisimilar 所用的 same_is_bisimulation：Same 本身构成 Bisimulation。
output.en: same_is_bisimulation, the checked core used by same_iff_bisimilar: Same itself forms a Bisimulation.

input.zh: branch_same_compatible 经 bisimulation_iff_compatible 接到左右接合，join_result_matches 再替换两个输入。
input.en: branch_same_compatible connects it to left/right joining via bisimulation_iff_compatible; join_result_matches then replaces both inputs.

conditions.zh: finite_outcomes_image_finite 验证有限纤维；无原子谓词；精确性及约简性另明示。
conditions.en: finite_outcomes_image_finite verifies finite fibers; no atomic predicates; exactness and reducedness are separately explicit.

detail.zh: 从单值共同操作接续到多结果关系；并非相同问题集下的无代价弱化。
detail.en: Continues from functional common operations to a multivalued relation, not a cost-free weakening for the identical question family.

detail.zh: 有限结果和丰富问答仍是前提；保持结果类而非每个原生三元事实。例子证明共同关系仍可多结果。任意解释的适用性及不同分节的共同对应未证。
detail.en: Finite outcomes and rich answers remain premises; outcome classes, not every native ternary fact, are preserved. The witness proves the common relation can remain multivalued. Applicability to every explanation and common correspondence across different articulations remain unproved.

detail.zh: 同一规律有可区分的左／右结果；规范共同表示仍非单值，且共享后继不同于分别可行的路径。
detail.en: One law has distinguishable left/right outcomes; the canonical account remains nonfunctional, and shared continuation differs from individually feasible paths.

limitations.zh: 有限结果和丰富问答仍是前提；保持结果类而非每个原生三元事实。例子证明共同关系仍可多结果。任意解释的适用性及不同分节的共同对应未证。
limitations.en: Finite outcomes and rich answers remain premises; outcome classes, not every native ternary fact, are preserved. The witness proves the common relation can remain multivalued. Applicability to every explanation and common correspondence across different articulations remain unproved.

validation_scope.zh: 所列 Lean 源码与成功冻结回执逐字哈希绑定；本轮223项审计含26项新声明。旧功能性定理信用此前166项回执，未冒充新证明。
validation_scope.en: Listed Lean sources bind by exact hash to successful frozen receipts. This round checks 223 declarations including 26 new ones. The older functional theorem credits its previous 166-audit receipt, not a new proof.

next_delta.zh: 从同一形成的不同关系分节取得共同细化或互译，不预设同一片段集与伙伴对齐；不重开已完成的有限结果恢复。
next_delta.en: Earn common refinement or translation between different articulations of the same formation without presupposing a common fragment set and partner alignment; reuse completed finite-outcome recovery.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：在既有接合情境研究中接续；已完成结果分别迁移，新连接与复用分列。
history.en: 2026-10-08: continued the existing joining-context study; migrated completed claims separately and distinguished new connections from reuse.
